entries.subject: ALMA primary size
entries.finding: The separately estimated ALMA primary size. The abstract paragraph beginning “Using the same approach” reports 838 ±44 km for Salacia and 393 ±33 km for Actaea. Only Salacia’s value sets this model’s diameter; [measurements](https://github.com/layoutit/css.earth/blob/8d2f45b58b5ea9a0b69a81242c51aa6e6d6ebcdf/src/planets/salacia/source/measurements.json) retain the extraction and uncertainty. See [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/layoutit/css.earth/blob/8d2f45b58b5ea9a0b69a81242c51aa6e6d6ebcdf/src/planets/salacia/NOTICE.md) for attribution.

entries.subject: JWST Salacia–Actaea spectrum for surface and axes
entries.finding: The [JWST Salacia–Actaea spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.17101) is spatially blended. Its **901 km** discussion concerns the system.
entries.revisitWhen: Spatially separated measurements of Salacia's surface or shape are published.

entries.subject: Older equal-albedo size estimate
entries.finding: The [older 866 ±37 km estimate](https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/aa6346) used equal-albedo binary partitioning; the newer resolved-component result is selected.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer resolved-component size overturns the ALMA estimate.
